question: How should the assignment path and historical exposure data be repaired without rewriting what participants actually saw?

criteria.instruction: Use the pinned account-keyed path, retain seed/experiment/rollout revision, exclude anonymous fallback and test session/device/name stability plus threshold expansion. Preserve actual historical variants and flag the contaminated period; reconcile eligibility/account-level outcomes rather than relabeling exposures to expected assignment or changing seed to hide history.
Cite repair review and exposure journal or E3 contract. Account-level measurement must not count repeated sessions/exposures as independent participants.
Do not claim complete repair, valid outcome analysis or historical counterfactual treatment was observed. The packet contains no finished outcome window.
